mapper.sql: select ha.*, ec.class_term, concat('第', ec.class_term, '期') as class_name, course.course_name, coalesce(publisher.real_name, publisher.nickname, publisher.username) as publish_teacher_name, coalesce(answer_teacher.real_name, answer_teacher.nickname, answer_teacher.username) as answer_publish_teacher_name from homework_assignment ha left join edu_class ec on ec.id = ha.class_id left join edu_course course on course.id = ha.course_id left join sys_user publisher on publisher.id = ha.publish_teacher_id left join sys_user answer_teacher on answer_teacher.id = ha.answer_publish_teacher_id
mapper.insert: insert into homework_assignment ( title, description, class_id, homework_date, course_id, course_detail_id, course_content_snapshot, attachment_name, attachment_url, attachment_type, answer_publish_status, publish_teacher_id, publish_date, deadline, status, allow_resubmit, student_count_snapshot ) values ( #{title}, #{description}, #{classId}, #{homeworkDate}, #{courseId}, #{courseDetailId}, #{courseContentSnapshot}, #{attachmentName}, #{attachmentUrl}, #{attachmentType}, #{answerPublishStatus}, #{publishTeacherId}, #{publishDate}, #{deadline}, #{status}, #{allowResubmit}, #{studentCountSnapshot} )
mapper.update: update homework_assignment set title = #{title}, description = #{description}, class_id = #{classId}, homework_date = #{homeworkDate}, course_id = #{courseId}, course_detail_id = #{courseDetailId}, course_content_snapshot = #{courseContentSnapshot}, attachment_name = #{attachmentName}, attachment_url = #{attachmentUrl}, attachment_type = #{attachmentType}, deadline = #{deadline}, allow_resubmit = #{allowResubmit} where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
update homework_assignment set deleted = 1 where id = #{id} and deleted = 0

update homework_assignment set answer_attachment_name = #{answerAttachmentName}, answer_attachment_url = #{answerAttachmentUrl}, answer_attachment_type = #{answerAttachmentType}, answer_publish_status = #{answerPublishStatus}, answer_publish_time = #{answerPublishTime}, answer_publish_teacher_id = #{answerPublishTeacherId} where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
